name: DealQualificationTracker
tagline: The Deal Qualification Tracker helps a sales team decide how real an opportunity is.
description: The Deal Qualification Tracker helps a sales team decide how real an opportunity is. It follows a well-known qualification framework - MEDDPICC (Metrics, Economic buyer, Decision criteria, Decision process, Paper process, Identify pain, Champion, Competition), MEDDICC, BANT or SPICED - and records, for each criterion, how sure you are, the evidence, and the person on the customer side.
features: A status per criterion (Unknown, Partial, Confirmed, Red flag) with evidence, buying-committee contact
Weighted 0-100 qualification score with Strong / Developing / Weak grade
Stage-gate check against the opportunity stage, stale-evidence flags
Coaching questions for the biggest gaps, filters, history
